It is difficult to help you with such a terse description of your problem. Can you give us a reproducible example of data and code that you cannot re-use?

Just a guess: JGR dialogs for saving data may be tricky. I remember having tried to save my data to a file via Save as..., and later finding that I only saved a single data frame from the workspace. To ensure that you saved all your data, you can use save.image().

Helios
